followOn.title: Follow-on Funding from SCRC-Funded Research (Not Yet Featured)
followOn.markdown:
We are delighted to share that researchers previously supported by Sussex Cancer Research Centre (SCRC) and Sussex Cancer Fund awards have secured major external follow-on funding to advance their projects:

- **Dr Antony Oliver — Blood Cancer UK (£29,991):** Following their August 2025 SCRC Pump-Priming Award (*"A new therapeutic option in acute myeloid leukaemia"*), [Antony Oliver](https://sussexcancer.org/directory/antony-oliver) has secured external funding from **Blood Cancer UK** of **£29,991** ([view award details](https://bloodcancer.org.uk/research/research-projects/developing-a-new-treatment-for-an-aggressive-form-of-acute-myeloid-leukaemia-aml/)).
- **Dr Frances Pearl — Cancer Research UK:** Following their Inaugural SCRC PhD Studentship (2025) (*"AI solutions to guide treatment strategies for Cancers of Unknown Primaries (CUPs)"*), [Frances Pearl](https://sussexcancer.org/directory/frances-pearl) has secured external funding from **Cancer Research UK** ([view award details](https://profiles.sussex.ac.uk/p140897-frances-pearl/grants)).
- **Dr Luke Yates — Academy of Medical Sciences (£125,000):** Following their 2024/25 SCRC Pump-Priming Award (*"PP4 as a novel target in the development of new therapies for ovarian cancer"*), Dr Luke Yates has secured external funding from **Academy of Medical Sciences** of **£125,000** ([view award details](https://www.sussex.ac.uk/broadcast/read/70537)).

Explore all SCRC-funded projects and their follow-on funding on the [SCRC Funding page](https://sussexcancer.org/funding).

### [New Themed meetings schedule now live](https://sussexcancer.org/news/new-themed-meetings-schedule-now-live)

*Published 17 November 2026*

We’re pleased to share the latest schedule of our SCRC themed meetings for October and November.

These groups are open to all students, so everyone is welcome to attend and get involved!

- 23/11 - Cancer Related Fatigue Group. 2-3 pm online on Teams
- 3/12 - Blood Cancer Group. 10-11 am Meeting room, Medical Research Building
- 10/12 - Breast & Gynae Group. 10-11 am Meeting room, Medical Research Building, and online on Teams
- 15/12 - Brain Cancer Group. 3-4 pm Kroto room, JMS Building

[Read the full story on sussexcancer.org](https://sussexcancer.org/news/new-themed-meetings-schedule-now-live).

---

### [Goodbye Breasts! Documentary now streaming online](https://sussexcancer.org/news/goodbye-breasts-documentary-now-streaming-online)

*Published 17 November 2026*

A love letter, a farewell and a giant boob. Goodbye Breasts! is now officially streaming online. You can watch the film from the comfort of your own home on Eventive, a global platform championing independent cinema. Whether you prefer tuning in on your computer or casting it to your television, the film is ready when you are.

[Read the full story on sussexcancer.org](https://sussexcancer.org/news/goodbye-breasts-documentary-now-streaming-online).

---

### [Apply Now for New Research Funding: Sussex Cancer Fund x SCRC Awards](https://sussexcancer.org/news/apply-now-for-new-research-funding-sussex-cancer-fund-x-scrc-awards)

*Published 17 November 2026*

We are excited to announce a new round of funding provided by the Sussex Cancer Fund (SCF) in partnership with the Sussex Cancer Research Centre (SCRC). The aim of these awards is to support innovative and impactful cancer research for the benefit of people with cancer.

Funding is available across two brackets:

- Awards up to £60k: For projects with significant input from doctors, nurses, or allied health professionals, *OR* projects with an short term route to patient benefit.
- Awards up to £20k: For projects that do not meet the above criteria but still maintain a strong rationale for how the work will benefit people with cancer.

[Read the full story on sussexcancer.org](https://sussexcancer.org/news/apply-now-for-new-research-funding-sussex-cancer-fund-x-scrc-awards).

---

### [SS REN and ARC KSS New Funding Opportunity](https://sussexcancer.org/news/ss-ren-and-arc-kss-new-funding-opportunity)

*Published 8 November 2026*

The Sussex & Surrey Research Engagement Network (SS REN), in partnership with the Applied Research Collaboration Kent, Surrey and Sussex (ARC KSS), is launching a new seed funding programme to support early engagement and partnership-building between researchers, communities and voluntary, community and social enterprise (VCSE) organisations. Further information [here](https://cur.at/k3zfTuU?m=web).

[Read the full story on sussexcancer.org](https://sussexcancer.org/news/ss-ren-and-arc-kss-new-funding-opportunity).

## Follow-on Funding from SCRC-Funded Research

*Suggested Curated.co category: Updates from the SCRC*

We are delighted to share that researchers previously supported by Sussex Cancer Research Centre (SCRC) and Sussex Cancer Fund awards have secured major external follow-on funding to advance their projects:

- **Dr Antony Oliver — Blood Cancer UK (£29,991):** Following their August 2025 SCRC Pump-Priming Award (*"A new therapeutic option in acute myeloid leukaemia"*), [Antony Oliver](https://sussexcancer.org/directory/antony-oliver) has secured external funding from **Blood Cancer UK** of **£29,991** ([view award details](https://bloodcancer.org.uk/research/research-projects/developing-a-new-treatment-for-an-aggressive-form-of-acute-myeloid-leukaemia-aml/)).

We are excited to announce a new round of funding provided by the Sussex Cancer Fund (SCF) in partnership with the Sussex Cancer Research Centre (SCRC). The aim of these awards is to support innovative and impactful cancer research for the benefit of people with cancer.

- Awards up to £60k: For projects with significant input from doctors, nurses, or allied health professionals, *OR* projects with an short term route to patient benefit.

followOn.markdown:
We are delighted to share that researchers previously supported by Sussex Cancer Research Centre (SCRC) and Sussex Cancer Fund awards have secured major external follow-on funding to advance their projects:

- **Dr Antony Oliver — Blood Cancer UK (£29,991):** Following their August 2025 SCRC Pump-Priming Award (*"A new therapeutic option in acute myeloid leukaemia"*), [Antony Oliver](https://sussexcancer.org/directory/antony-oliver) has secured external funding from **Blood Cancer UK** of **£29,991** ([view award details](https://bloodcancer.org.uk/research/research-projects/developing-a-new-treatment-for-an-aggressive-form-of-acute-myeloid-leukaemia-aml/)).
- **Dr Frances Pearl — Cancer Research UK & UKRI Proof of Concept:** Following their Inaugural SCRC PhD Studentship (2025) (*"AI solutions to guide treatment strategies for Cancers of Unknown Primaries (CUPs)"*), [Frances Pearl](https://sussexcancer.org/directory/frances-pearl) has secured external funding from **Cancer Research UK** — *Strategy for the findability and accessibility of CRUK data* ([view details](https://profiles.sussex.ac.uk/p140897-frances-pearl/grants)); and **UKRI Proof of Concept** — *Pearl AI – DependANT* ([view details](https://www.ukri.org/news/48-projects-backed-to-turn-cutting-edge-research-into-businesses/)).
- **Dr Luke Yates — Academy of Medical Sciences (£125,000):** Following their 2024/25 SCRC Pump-Priming Award (*"PP4 as a novel target in the development of new therapies for ovarian cancer"*), Dr Luke Yates has secured external funding from **Academy of Medical Sciences** of **£125,000** ([view award details](https://www.sussex.ac.uk/broadcast/read/70537)).

Explore all SCRC-funded projects and their follow-on funding on the [SCRC Funding page](https://sussexcancer.org/funding).

## Follow-on Funding from SCRC-Funded Research

*Suggested Curated.co category: Updates from the SCRC*

We are delighted to share that researchers previously supported by Sussex Cancer Research Centre (SCRC) and Sussex Cancer Fund awards have secured major external follow-on funding to advance their projects:

- **Dr Antony Oliver — Blood Cancer UK (£29,991):** Following their August 2025 SCRC Pump-Priming Award (*"A new therapeutic option in acute myeloid leukaemia"*), [Antony Oliver](https://sussexcancer.org/directory/antony-oliver) has secured external funding from **Blood Cancer UK** of **£29,991** ([view award details](https://bloodcancer.org.uk/research/research-projects/developing-a-new-treatment-for-an-aggressive-form-of-acute-myeloid-leukaemia-aml/)).

We are excited to announce a new round of funding provided by the Sussex Cancer Fund (SCF) in partnership with the Sussex Cancer Research Centre (SCRC). The aim of these awards is to support innovative and impactful cancer research for the benefit of people with cancer.

## Follow-on Funding from SCRC-Funded Research
